hypotheses.justification: Without this instance, apply tsub_le_iff_left and commute the right-hand side to reduce the goal to a + c ≤ (b + (a - b)) + c. By tsub_le_iff_right, this is equivalent to (a + c) - c ≤ b + (a - b), which follows from add_tsub_le_right.trans le_add_tsub. All three lemmas are proved earlier without AddLeftMono. This argument uses only the remaining axioms and also covers trivial types; empty types are vacuous.
